# Earn the Rung

<p class="lens-meta"><code class="lens-code">RUNG</code> · Modern — analytic and scientific method · <strong>Enforced — owns a gate</strong></p>

## The failure it names

asserting intervention or counterfactual conclusions from observational data, and stating a conclusion with no boundary conditions

## What it does

a claim above the association rung requires an executed protocol supporting it; every claim declares its boundaries

## Enforced gates

These block a citation packet deterministically — no model in the loop:

- `PEIR-CAUSAL-RUNG-UNREACHED`
- `PEIR-BOUNDARIES-MISSING`

## Worked example

"This Amcache entry proves execution" is a rung-3 assertion resting on rung-1 data, with no Windows build named. Nothing was intervened on; nothing was compared against a world where the file was only copied.

## Sources

- Judea Pearl, The Book of Why (2018), ch. 1 — the ladder of causation
- Austin Bradford Hill, Proc. R. Soc. Med. 58 (1965) 295
